articles.summary: – Investment deepens strategic partnership and supports development of differentiated nextgeneration power semiconductor solutions SEOUL, South Korea–(BUSINESS WIRE)—Magnachip Semiconductor Corporation (NYSE: MX) (“Magnachip” or the “Company”), a designer and manufacturer of analog and mixed-signal power semiconductor platform solutions, today announced that Navitas Semiconductor Corporation (Nasdaq: NVTS) (“Navitas”) has agreed to make a $5 million strategic equity […] The post Magnachip Announces Strategic Investment by Navitas Semiconductor appeared first on Magnachip Semiconductor .
